    The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
(9) Q_{g l c}=\frac{\mu}{Y_{x,g l c}}+m_{g l c}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{glc}, code proposes constitutive]
(10) \frac{d([G L N])}{d t}=-Q_{g l n}V X_{\nu}-K_{d g l n}V[G L N]+F_{i n}[G L N]_{i n}-F_{o u t}[G L N]    [code: ODE, computes [GLN], code proposes balance]
(11) Q_{g l n}=\frac{\mu}{Y_{x,g l n}}+m_{g l n}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{gln}, code proposes constitutive]
(12) m_{g l n}=\frac{\alpha_{1}[G L N]}{\alpha_{2}+[G L N]}    [code: algebraic, computes m_{gln}, code proposes constitutive]
    The mass balances for lactate and ammonia are
(13) \frac{d([L A C])}{d t}=Q_{l a c}V X_{\nu}-F_{o u t}[L A C]    [code: ODE, computes [LAC], code proposes balance]
(14) Q_{l a c}=Y_{l a c,g l c}Q_{g l c}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{lac}, code proposes constitutive]
(15) \frac{d([{A M M}])}{d t}=Q_{{a m m}}V X_{\nu}+K_{{d g l n}}V[{G L N}]-F_{{o u t}}[{A M M}]    [code: ODE, computes [AMM], code proposes balance]
(16) Q_{a m m}=Y_{a m m,g l n}Q_{g l n}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{amm}, code proposes constitutive]

Symbols:
  Q_{glc}: specific glucose consumption rate per cell mass [mmol g^{-1} h^{-1}] (computed)
  \mu: Specific viable cell growth rate [h^-1] (computed)
  Y_{x,glc}: yield of cells on glucose [cell/mmol] (parameter)
  m_{glc}: maintenance coefficient of glucose [mmol/cell·h^{-1}] (parameter)
  [GLN]: glutamine concentration in the reactor [mmol L^{-1}] (computed)
  Q_{gln}: specific glutamine consumption rate per cell mass [mmol g^{-1} h^{-1}] (computed)
  V: Reactor liquid volume [L] (computed)
  X_{\nu}: Viable cell concentration (viable cell density) [cells L^-1] (computed)
  K_{dgln}: constant for glutamine degradation [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  F_{in}: Inlet volumetric flow rate into the bioreactor [L h^-1] (variable)
  [GLN]_{in}: glutamine concentration in the inlet feed [mmol L^{-1}] (variable)
  F_{out}: Outlet volumetric flow rate from the bioreactor [L h^-1] (variable)
  Y_{x,gln}: yield of cells on glutamine [cell/mmol] (parameter)
  m_{gln}: maintenance coefficient of glutamine (Michaelis‑Menten form) [mmol/cell·h^{-1}] (computed)
  \alpha_{1}: constant of glutamine maintenance coefficient [mM L/cell/h] (parameter)
  \alpha_{2}: constant of glutamine maintenance coefficient [mM] (parameter)
  [LAC]: Extracellular lactate concentration [mM] (computed)
  Q_{lac}: specific lactate production rate derived from glucose consumption (computed)
  Y_{lac,glc}: yield of lactate on glucose (mmol lactate per mmol glucose) [mmol/mmol] (parameter)
  [AMM]: Extracellular ammonia concentration [mM] (computed)
  Q_{amm}: specific ammonia production rate derived from glutamine consumption (computed)
  Y_{amm,gln}: yield of ammonia on glutamine (mmol ammonia per mmol glutamine) [mmol/mmol] (parameter)
